page.layout: One page of text in two columns, with marginal notes in the right margin. Running head at top, page number at top right. Main text runs full width; the right margin holds short notes beside the text.

main_text.head: Explicatio 1.
main_text.p: A. C. 1466 Borussia in Casimiri Regis Poloniæ clientelam sese tradidit, & divisa fuit in Regium & Cruciferorum, quæ A. C. 1525. in Ducatum conversa, & Alberto Marchioni Brandeburgensi, ultimo Ordinis Teutonici Magistro, tradita fuit, à cujus posteritate hodieq; possidetur.
main_text.head: Explicatio 2.
main_text.p: Sic quoq; Livonia A. C. 1561. ad Polonos concessit, ac abrogato Crucciferorum ordine Gothardus Ketlerus Dux Curlandiæ ac Semigalliæ creatus fuit. Reliquam Livoniam Polonis eripuerunt Sveci.Livo-niam.
main_text.head: Periodus III.
Canon I.
main_text.p: Extinctis Jagellonidis Polonia exteros Reges habere cœpit.(4) Regum mutatio.
main_text.head: Explicatio.
main_text.p: A. C. 1573 Henricus Dux Andegavensis, Caroli IX Galliæ Regis frater,

page.notes: The right margin notes were read as "Livo-niam." beside Explicatio 2 and "(4) Regum mutatio." beside Canon I. The first note is split across the line by a hyphen. Italic display of the names "Gothardus Ketlerus" and "Henricus Dux Andegavensis" is uncertain; the gothic-style "Gothar" and "Henricus" letters are doubtful. The word "Crucciferorum" is a probable misprint for "Crucifer-orum" as printed. The text continues onto the next page with "ter," at the bottom of the page.
